people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.
translations.bsb: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel was shapely and beautiful.
translations.kjv: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.
translations.asv: And Leah's eyes were tender. But Rachel was beautiful and well favored.
